title: Asymptotic Contractivity of Bohnenblust-Hille Constants with Bounded Monomial Support
summary: We study the optimal Bohnenblust-Hille constants $ K_{ m , M } $ for complex $ m $-homogeneous polynomials in any number of variables whose monomials with nonzero coefficient involve at most $M$ variables. For every fixed $M$, we prove that these constants satisfy \[ K_{ m , M } \leq A_{ M }^{ M / m } \cdot m^{ ( M^2 - 1 ) / ( 2m ) } \, , \quad \text{for} \ m \geq M \, , \] where $ A_{ M } \geq 1 $ depends only on $ M $. In particular, \[ K_{ m , M } \to 1 \quad \text{as} \ m \to \infty \, , \] and so the corresponding Bohnenblust-Hille constants are asymptotically contractive. The proof…
